Hi Todd,

Glad Georges got you sorted. That matches what I have on Shop····: your B30 is in the second batch, leaving the manufacturer's warehouse end of October / first week of November, with the Power Kit in the same box. Tracking goes out to this address the moment it ships, so it's worth adding us to your contacts in case anything lands in junk.

You can also follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

It was a pleasure helping you. If you were happy with how things were handled, a short review on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You're also welcome in our Discord for product news and hands-on help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
